Professional bio

Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko brings nearly 10 years of practical experience in applying digital technologies in agriculture, with a primary focus on computer vision and deep learning for plant phenotyping and food quality assurance.

She is co-founder and CEO of Petiole, a UK-based SME developing practical AI tools for agriculture and plant science. The global platform Petiole Pro, developed by Maryna’s team, was named a finalist in the GIST Tech-I 2015 competition in the USA, shortlisted for the UK FPC Fresh Awards 2023, and received three grants from Innovate UK — the UK government’s innovation agency — and one Horizon Europe grant, for practical AI applications in agricultural challenges such as pest and disease detection.

Maryna was recognised as a LinkedIn Top Voice in May 2026 and has an active educational presence in social and business media.

Dr Maryna Kuzmenko is a winner of the Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award 2025/26, announced on 5 August 2026, for MooMore — an AI and thermal imaging system that detects inflammation in dairy cows before lameness develops. The award carries a £75,000 grant and a twelve-month programme running to June 2027. She was one of 61 grant winners among 100 women founders recognised from 1,590 applications.

She is one of 16 Community Forum Members of the 2025/26 Cohort, pre-selected by the Innovate UK Women in Innovation team. Maryna is also an Oxford Farming Conference 2026 Inspire Fellow.

Maryna is a fellow of the “Scaling Young Women’s Businesses Through IP Mentorship” programme by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the International Trade Centre’s SheTrades initiative. She is Virgin StartUp Alumna 2020.

She is a regular speaker at educational events and has participated in high-level agriculture-focused meetings in the United Kingdom and internationally.

Short bio — 300 characters

Dr Maryna Kuzmenko speaks and trains on AI in agriculture for agrifood events and teams. A LinkedIn Top Voice, she founded MooMore, co-founded Petiole, writes the AI in Agriculture book series, and won the Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award 2025/26.

100-word bio

Dr Maryna Kuzmenko is a UK-based speaker and trainer on AI in agriculture. She gives keynotes at agrifood conferences and industry meetings, trains agrifood teams in practical AI literacy, and writes for a 38K+ LinkedIn community as a LinkedIn Top Voice. Her work returns to one problem: a measurement that matters is locked behind specialist equipment, so the people who need it never take it. With Petiole Pro the answer was a smartphone camera, now used by research organisations on six continents. With MooMore, winner of the Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award 2025/26, it is thermal imaging that catches lameness in dairy cows early.

First-person bio

I speak and train on AI in agriculture, for conference audiences, boards and agrifood teams, and I build the thing I talk about. MooMore uses thermal imaging and on-device AI to catch lameness in dairy cows before anyone can see it, and it won the Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award 2025/26. Before that I spent a decade on the crop side with Petiole, building measurement tools now used by research organisations on six continents. I write about all of it as a LinkedIn Top Voice, and in the AI in Agriculture book series.
